summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests AWT020, a study drug, in adults with advanced solid tumors. AWT020 is given as an intravenous infusion once every three weeks at designated dose levels, and the length of treatment is not stated. The study aims to establish the maximum tolerated dose and/or recommended Phase 2 dose, and to learn about safety, tolerability, efficacy, pharmacokinetics and immunogenicity.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa AWT020, un medicamento en investigación, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados. AWT020 se administra como infusión intravenosa una vez cada tres semanas, en niveles de dosis designados; la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El estudio busca establecer la dosis máxima tolerada y/o la dosis recomendada para Fase 2, y conocer la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la eficacia, la farmacocinética y la inmunogenicidad.
who_for: Age 18 or older and able to give written informed consent.
Unresectable advanced solid tumor confirmed by pathology.
Disease progressed after at least one systemic therapy, with no beneficial standard option available or tolerated.
At least one measurable lesion by RECIST 1.1, ECOG 0 or 1, and life expectancy of at least 3 months.
Adequate bone marrow, kidney, liver, clotting and heart function as defined in the protocol.
not_for: Prior immunotherapy stopped because of an immune-related adverse event, or hypersensitivity to study treatment or related therapies.
Untreated or unstable brain metastases, leptomeningeal disease, or brainstem metastases.
Autoimmune or skin disease needing systemic treatment, or current or past interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis.
Active or recent severe infection, or other uncontrolled medical condition.
Pregnancy or breastfeeding, or another malignancy within 5 years (low-risk or in situ cancers permitted).
